notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Fixed:

-Music and sounds were disabled by default. If you still don't have sound, just add it in the settings menu.
-Localization in some languages was not translated correctly .
-Some user interface buttons have been improved.
- Optimization has been done on some mini-game levels.
